_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: And when I'm 6 ft under the earth, and time has taken everything it can from me, it still won't find a way to take you from my heart. Somewhere beneath all that silence will remain the echo of a love so deep that even death arrived too late to erase it.
